items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-15
items.q: I knew him there. Emil Parra.

ctx.x: Well, when you played these jobs, would anybody ever have an MC or anything like that?

Well, in the old days, quite often we'd play for a big dance in the tea room and there'd be five acts of floor shows. We'd have to play for the five acts of the floor show. I don't know if you remember the late Emil Parra. Oh yeah. I sang for years and years at Pat O'Brien's. I knew him there. Emil Parra. Well, let me tell you, Emil Parra was always an MC and he was one of the greatest MCs in New Orleans that I've ever seen. And every time we had five acts of floor shows, a play after the dance, or maybe during…
Did he? He must have been in the 50s when he passed. I would imagine that around the time. Somewhere around that time.
